The successful candidate will contribute to RF network design, system integration, network commissioning, testing and ongoing performance optimisation across multi-operator carrier and in-building environments.  The position supports to the engineering delivery of wireless network deployments involving major mobile operators such as Telstra, Optus and Vodafone, supporting integration, validation and technical documentation activities across indoor and macro network projects.   Benefits   Competitive salary aligned with skills and industry experience.  Opportunity to contribute to RF, DAS and wireless network projects across major Australian carrier environments (Telstra, Optus and Vodafone).  Exposure to interstate telecommunications deployments and multi-site engineering activities.  Ongoing professional development within a specialised telecommunications engineering team.    Task & responsibilities   Contribute to the integration, optimisation and performance monitoring of telecommunications network systems across RF and in-building wireless environments.  Support testing, commissioning and validation of 4G, 5G and legacy cellular technologies to ensure network performance targets are achieved.  Conduct RF performance analysis and contribute to troubleshooting activities under engineering supervision.  Prepare technical documentation, site records and engineering reports in line with Australian standards and project requirements.  Collaborate with project engineers, vendors and field technicians to maintain network reliability, compliance and service quality.  Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to network performance and system optimisation.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering or related discipline.  3+ years of hands-on experience in telecommunications network engineering, including RF systems and in-building coverage environments.   Demonstrated application of telecommunications engineering principles including system integration, performance evaluation and network optimisation within carrier-grade environments.  Proven experience in telecommunications network engineering within RF and in-building environments.  Strong knowledge of LTE (4G), 5G NR and Wi-Fi, with understanding of legacy cellular technologies.  Experience with In-Building Coverage (IBC), repeater systems and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS).  Experience using RF performance analysis and data collection tools such as TEMS, NEMO and GIS/RF planning tools (MapInfo, iBwave or similar).  Proficiency with RF test and measurement equipment, including spectrum analysers, RF scanners, RF signal generators, and cable and antenna testing equipment.  Demonstrated application of RF engineering principles including link budget calculations and system performance evaluation.  Ability to produce technical documentation using engineering design tools (Visio or similar).   About Company     Entelso Pty Ltd is an Australian telecommunications solutions provider specialising in network design, RF engineering and in-building coverage solutions across carrier and enterprise environments. We design and implement wireless connectivity solutions supporting major Australian mobile network operators including Telstra, Optus and Vodafone,   delivered through established supply chain partners.    The company provides nationwide delivery capability across telecommunications infrastructure projects, including Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), repeater technologies and network optimisation solutions. This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 3-4 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Preferably a university degree or higher education qualifications. Highly proficient in the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Excellent ability to analyse and manipulate data, extracting insights for reporting.

Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, hybrid cloud infrastructure, Windows Server, virtualisation (VMware-Hyper-V), and Microsoft 365. 

Experience managing identity, security, networking, SharePoint, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. 

Strong skills in infrastructure security, patching, vulnerability management, automation (PowerShell-Python), and troubleshooting. 

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, customer service, and project delivery capabilities.

Buterin L’Estrange Projects is proudly based in West Gosford, NSW, delivering exceptional outcomes across the commercial construction sector. Specialising in commercial construction, adaptive re-use projects, and premium retail fit-outs, we combine over 50 years of industry expertise with a modern, innovative, and agile approach to project delivery.

Our team is committed to creating high-quality spaces through smart solutions, strong partnerships, and a hands-on approach that ensures every project is delivered with precision, efficiency, and attention to detail.

We are currently searching for a Mechanical Engineer to join our growing team.

The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the design, engineering, documentation and technical coordination of projects from concept through to manufacture and installation. This role supports the successful delivery of commercial, retail, hospitality and bespoke joinery projects by producing accurate engineering designs, detailed shop drawings, CNC files, material schedules and technical documentation.

The Mechanical Engineer works closely with project managers, estimators, production staff, suppliers and clients to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time and within budget.

Key responsibilities include

Engineering & Design:
- Prepare mechanical designs for commercial joinery and bespoke products.
- Produce detailed manufacturing drawings using AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
- Develop 2D and 3D models for client presentation and manufacturing.
- Review architectural drawings and specifications.
- Ensure all designs comply with relevant Australian Standards and project requirements.
- Resolve technical design issues throughout the project lifecycle.

Manufacturing Support:
- Prepare fabrication and shop drawings for production.
- Produce CNC machining files.
- Generate Bills of Materials (BOM).
- Generate Bills of Quantities (BOQ).
- Coordinate design changes with production staff.
- Provide technical support to the workshop during manufacture.

Project Coordination:
- Assist Project Managers with technical planning.
- Coordinate with architects, consultants and clients regarding design requirements.
- Monitor engineering progress to meet project deadlines.
- Assist with prototype development where required.
- Participate in project meetings.

Estimating Support:
- Complete quantity take-offs from tender documentation;
- Assist with material selection;
- Review engineering requirements during tender preparation;
- Provide technical advice during estimating.

Quality & Continuous Improvement:
- Ensure drawings are accurate before release.
- Maintain document control.
- Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency.
- Assist in reducing production errors and rework.

Health, Safety & Compliance:
- Comply with WHS legislation and company policies.
- Ensure engineering designs consider safe manufacture and installation.
- Follow company quality management procedures.
- Participate in toolbox meetings and safety initiatives.

To be considered you will need a relevant Bachelor Degree and at least 1 year of related employment experience.

This is a full time position, an immediate start is available. A remuneration package of $80,000 - $90,000 per annum will be offered to the successful candidate.
